description.zh: 节点异常问题结束时间。按照 ISO8601 标准表示，带时区的时间格式，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss+0800
description.en: The end time of the node issue. The time is in the ISO 8601 format \`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss+0800\` and includes the time zone.

description.zh:
异常问题的类别。当Reason=HardwareError时，此值为必填项。取值范围：</br>
● hardware-cpu-error：CPU 故障</br>
● hardware-gpu-error：GPU 故障</br>
● hardware-motherboard-error：主板故障</br>
● hardware-mem-error：内存故障</br>
● hardware-power-error：电源故障</br>
● hardware-disk-error：磁盘故障
● hardware-networkcard-error：网卡故障</br>
● hardware-fan-error：风扇故障</br>
● hardware-cable-error：网线故障</br>
● others：其他
description.en:
The category of the issue. This parameter is required when \`Reason\` is set to \`HardwareError\`. Valid values:
● hardware-cpu-error: CPU failure
● hardware-gpu-error: GPU failure
● hardware-motherboard-error: Motherboard failure
● hardware-mem-error: Memory failure
● hardware-power-error: Power supply failure
● hardware-disk-error: Disk failure ● hardware-networkcard-error: Network interface card failure
● hardware-fan-error: Fan failure
● hardware-cable-error: Network cable failure
● others: Other

description.zh:
异常问题对灵骏节点造成的影响。
取值范围（枚举值）：
● HardwareError：硬件出现异常
● SoftwareError：软件出现异常
● NetworkError：网络出现异常
● Others：其他异常问题。当以上影响类型不符合条件时，您可以设置Reason=Others并在Description中描述更多信息。
description.en:
The impact of the issue on the Lingjun node.
Valid values:
● HardwareError: A hardware error occurred.
● SoftwareError: A software error occurred.
● NetworkError: A network error occurred.
● Others: Other issues. If none of the preceding values apply, set this parameter to \`Others\` and provide details in the \`Description\` parameter.

description.zh: 节点异常问题开始时间。按照 ISO8601 标准表示，带时区的时间格式，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss+0800
description.en: The start time of the node issue. The time is in the ISO 8601 format \`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss+0800\` and includes the time zone.

descriptions.zh: 创建会话的接口，返回前端EndPoint，并且起一个周期任务跟踪会话状态
descriptions.en: Creates a session, returns a frontend endpoint, and starts a periodic task to track the session status.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eflo-controller report-nodes-status --nodes e01-cn-fou3yvon53d --start-time 2024-09-22T16:00:00Z --end-time 2024-07-10T10:17:06 --reason SoftwareError --description dwd_mysql_lingwan_faxing_login_di --issue-category hardware-disk-error --region cn-hangzhou
